key.name: dry-run
key.description: Ask monmux to show the command a switch would run instead of running it.

key.name: serial-targeting
key.description: When more than one supported monitor is attached, read their serial numbers so that a click can target one. Off by default: while it is off, serial numbers are never read.

key.name: shortcut-1
key.description: The keyboard shortcut that switches to the input named in shortcut-1-input. Empty for none.

key.name: shortcut-1-input
key.description: The input shortcut 1 switches to, by the name monmux gives it. Which display that is stays monmux's decision.
